sentences.text: Streptococcus is a large bacterial genus spanning dozens of described species; it includes important pathogens of humans and is reported to cause substantial economic losses to agriculture.
Streptococci are among the first bacteria to colonise the mouth, can be acquired soon after birth, and the genus is divided into eight groups, six containing oral species.
Different oral surfaces carry characteristic streptococcal communities, with early dental plaque associated with Streptococcus sanguis, Streptococcus mitis biovar 1 and Streptococcus oralis.
Studies have associated excessive acidification of the mouth by aciduric species such as Streptococcus mutans with the development of dental caries.
